_comment: Range [min, max] of the pre-fix likelihood table actually deployed at diagnosis time (Sec. III-G / Table V, 'Old' column). Built from the angle_deg pixel-pitch bug era, before the tilt-feature fix in features.py; the source data that produced it predates this repository and is not separately released, but the resulting range is a fixed historical fact reproduced here so rebuild_likelihoods_loso_check.py runs without extra inputs.
